checks.notes: Pre-edit baseline on starting HEAD: 191 passed in 174s. Verifies the pre-change tree was green before edits.

6 new CliRunner tests (isolated HYPELAB_DB, no service mocks): add/list/show flow, bump-rules provenance validity, refresh-budget dict + bare-number forms, clean errors for bad budget JSON and unknown ids. 6/6 pass.
Post-edit full suite: 197 passed (191 baseline + 6 new), 0 failed, in 175s. No regressions.

Real-CLI challenge on a scratch DB (/tmp/chal.db): add, list, show, bump-rules --by dino, refresh-budget --by dino all exit 0. Final show: rules_version 2, rules replaced, budget_seen_usd 250.0 with timestamp, rules_provenance and budget_provenance round-trip as structured {who, source_url, captured_at} JSON through campaigns._parse (this is the path that raised JSONDecodeError before the provenance fix).

lessons: Provenance stored as TEXT but parsed with json.loads on read is a latent contract break: refresh-budget passed its own tests only until the next load. Any field that round-trips through _parse must be JSON at write time; the CLI is the right place to enforce the shape.

Old-kit severities (S1-S4 with a pick-higher-when-torn rule) do not transfer mechanically to the v3.0 scale: BLD-008's S1 was inflated for a single-user local-CLI trust model with mitigations in place, and was downgraded to S3 on challenge.

Phase 4 triage reports were lost when the Tech Lead's work lived outside the repo; re-deriving triage from durable lane findings was possible but cost a cycle. Final artifacts must be committed to the repo before an agent finishes.
The threadripper-ssh helper wraps commands in a way that breaks triple-quoted heredoc python; piping edit scripts via stdin is reliable.

next_action.reason: T-001 is implemented and verified (197/197 green, e2e challenge passed). The queue head is now T-002: DAT-350 feed_back() provenance filter (S1, effort XS) - a two-line fix with a unit test.

root_cause: Two CLI/service contract mismatches made campaign operator commands fail on every invocation: (1) b2cli passed the --by string where campaigns.bump_rules() requires provenance={who, source_url, captured_at}; (2) b2cli passed the entire budget JSON object where campaigns.refresh_budget() requires seen_usd: float. Plus two smaller contract defects: list read a nonexistent status key (schema column is state) and show caught KeyError while campaigns.load raises CampaignError.

source_identity.method: git commit hash on branch devteam/review-2026-09-29; local commits only, no push. Checks ran against the working tree identical to commit 5c76afe for hypelab/ and tests/ (docs-only STATUS/JOURNAL edits landed during the full-suite run and cannot affect test outcomes).

summary: HL-001: reconciled the lost Phase 4 triage into an authoritative queue (devteam/TASKS.md, all 200 lane findings accounted for, severities remapped to the v3.0 S0-S3/Idea scale, duplicates merged, BLD-008 challenged S1->S3) and implemented the top queue item T-001: the broken campaign CLI/service contract. campaign bump-rules built a provenance dict the service requires (was: operator string -> CampaignError on every invocation); campaign refresh-budget extracts a numeric seen_usd from a bare number or {budget_seen_usd} object with clean errors (was: whole dict passed to float() -> uncaught TypeError); adjacent latent defect fixed: refresh-budget stored a raw operator string in budget_provenance, which campaigns._parse() json.loads() on the next load -> JSONDecodeError, so the CLI now stores the same JSON provenance shape as bump-rules. campaign list prints the schema state column (was KeyError on nonexistent status); campaign show catches CampaignError for unknown ids (was KeyError catch that never fired). 6 new CliRunner tests on an isolated SQLite DB. Full suite: 197 passed (191 baseline + 6 new). End-to-end challenge via the real CLI: add -> list -> show -> bump-rules -> refresh-budget all exit 0, rules_version 1->2, budget 250.0 timestamped, both provenances round-trip as structured JSON.
